messages:
maya: Heads-up — changelog-bot skipped our PRs during the nightly aggregation. Noticed missing entries for #4821 and #4832. Need a late-merge exception to land a tiny fix to release-helper that re-parses PR bodies. cc @ryan @jess
ryan: ah okay, what caused it?
maya: looks like the prerelease label parsing regex fails on multiline 'BREAKING' sections. quick patch: 
```
- const re = /#CHANGELOG:\s*(.+)/
+ const re = /#CHANGELOG:\s*([\s\S]+?)\n\n/  // allow multiline
```
maya: patch is ~2 lines, tests added. Would prefer to land to ensure changelog completeness before tag. request: late-merge exception for release-2026.1.0. will not affect binaries.
jess: is this docs-only? any runtime risk?
maya: yes docs-only. only modifies release-helper script used by pipeline. no new deps.
lin: adding to the exception queue. @release-bot can you add a checklist?
release-bot: [automated] Exception request recorded: #exc-20260301-7. Need code owner approval and oncall ack.
sam: mapping owner is @ryan — please ack.
ryan: I can review now. give me 10.
jess: if ryan approves, I'm +1 for exception.
ryan: looked at patch, LGTM. tests pass locally. Putting approval in PR.
sre-oncall: oncall ack for low-risk infra change. :white_check_mark: 
maya: thanks all — will merge and trigger re-run of changelog job. tagging release manager.
jess: thanks. also remind release team to re-run changelog job after tag.
maya: noted. I'll ping in #release when job completes :smile:
